description: This file defines the MonkeySourceRandomScript class, which manages multiple script sources for the Android Monkey testing framework, allowing scripts to be run in sequence or randomly. It handles setup scripts, randomization, and event generation from multiple scripts.

classes.name: MonkeySourceRandomScript
classes.description: A class that manages multiple MonkeySourceScript instances to generate MonkeyEvents for testing, supporting random selection and setup scripting.

methods.name: MonkeySourceRandomScript
methods.description: Constructs an instance with optional setup script and multiple script files, initializing internal sources, randomizer, and configuration.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Returns the next MonkeyEvent from the current script source, selecting a new source if needed.

methods.name: setVerbose
methods.description: Sets verbosity level for itself and all subordinate script sources.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if all script sources are valid, returning true only if all are valid.
